title: Dot NDE 904
content:
In 1969, I was in a head-on collision and suffered broken bones and head trauma. A lady in white, like an angel, was with me a lot until I regained consciousness. In 1987, during the birth of my son by a student doctor, my heart rate dropped to 46. I then went into a tunnel, like the universe. There are dark shadows and it smells like sin, evil, and awfulness. A light is in the distance, I'm getting closer. ‘Oh good, soon I will be safely out of this stench’, I say to myself. Then I'm in front of a table. A higher power is there in front of me. I am a light entity. Around me are more light entities. There are also dark entities around me. I don't like them. A higher power is showing us a mission to do. We are looking in the table. It's Earth in there. The higher power shows us two ways to accomplish our mission: one of which he prefers us to do, the other one he isn't crazy about, but it seems that the main thing he is interested in is whether we will we do it the way he asks, yes or no. We have free choice. No one is looking at him, nor at the other spirits near him. They're different than us white and dark ones. Maybe they are what people refer to as angels. They aren't human spirits though, because we're all either white or dark. The white ones don't like the dark ones. Why is he giving them a chance to be with us on Earth too? ‘Ok, yes, I will do as you wish’. He sends two of the entities on his right with me. So many of the entities near me are telling me: ‘I will meet you here and there’. Some even said they will be my children in this life. So many spirits with me. We all love one another. Now, I meet people and I realize the reason I feel so comfortable with them is that I knew them over there. He shows us who we will be born to, inherited diseases, even our death. I can't remember why and what I'm supposed to be doing though.

arrival.other_being_detail: “A lady in white, like an angel” (1969). In 1987: “A higher power” present; “more light entities”; “dark entities”; other spirits “different… Maybe… angels.”

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark shadows; “smells like sin, evil, and awfulness”; later “in front of a table… It’s Earth in there.”

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: “A higher power is showing us a mission to do… [shows] two ways to accomplish our mission… the main thing he is interested in is whether we will… do it the way he asks, yes or no.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: 1969 head-on collision with broken bones and head trauma; also reports 1987 childbirth event with heart rate drop to 46.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pre-birth/mission-planning scene at a “table” showing Earth; presence of light and dark entities; “lady in white, like an angel” (1969).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with distressing darkness/stench → distant light → scene at a table with higher power and entities; includes pre-birth planning elements rather than a typical boundary/return description.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Strong pre-birth planning/mission briefing: viewing Earth “in the table,” being shown “who we will be born to, inherited diseases, even our death,” and spirits saying they will be encountered and may be “my children in this life.” Also notable olfactory component: “smells like sin, evil, and awfulness.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There are dark shadows and it smells like sin, evil, and awfulness.”; “Ok, yes, I will do as you wish.”; “I will meet you here and there.”; “Some even said they will be my children in this life.”
